summary: Unified resumable delivery controller for Taskand

delivery.outcome: Expose a resumable, idempotent delivery coordinator that delegates queue, PR and protected merge effects to Koru, Goal and Validator.
nonGoals: Direct GitHub merge, branch-protection, CI or production deployment changes

architecture.decision: Use a small Node adapter with an atomic, content-addressed state record outside Git. Default mode observes Git and emits the exact delegated command plan; explicit pull-request and merge flags advance the same state machine through Koru, Goal and the protected Validator.
dataChanges: Ignored recovery state under the configured XDG state directory
architecture.rollback: Remove the additive CLI route and delivery adapter; ignored state can be retained for forensic recovery.

validation.evidence: Injected runner verifies ordered, resumable phases
Protected Validator command and fail-closed merge guards
Managed governance and focused stack checks
